limitations: Finite fixed/domain samples and SM103 only; performance equality is resolved within observed measurement uncertainty, not an exact-time guarantee.

paired_performance.method: Median of all paired round ratios, 10000 deterministic bootstrap resamples; raw mean-log estimator also retained. No samples discarded.

balanced_order_performance.method: Geometric mean of the two allocation-order strata's median paired ratios. Each ratio is measured on one GPU within one job; no absolute latencies are combined across GPUs. Stratified bootstrap, 10000 draws, all rounds retained.
